page.notes: Lower right catchword "ciem" is partly unclear. Uncertain: the marks at the start of the first paragraph ("5", "2") and "55" before "finem"; "De Somno" is read with a doubt. The printed line "conuenerti" is uncertain. Left margin note "Quae respectu malu etiam inducat ratio finis." is not transcribed as a separate note because it could not be fully read at the scan resolution. Digitiser watermark at lower right and show-through were left out.
